name: story-index
purpose: Every success story of a company as one filterable library. A left-aligned title sits over a toolbar — a search field and one select per facet (industry, solution, product) on one row, each starting with an option that clears it — then a grid of story cards and a load-more button that reveals the next page. Below `lg` the toolbar folds to the search field (with its shorter placeholder) and a filter button that reveals the selects, with each applied facet listed under it as a removable chip. A select with more than seven options gains an option search. Each card is one link named by its company: the client mark in a single ink, the story's category as an overline, its description and a read cue whose arrow nudges on hover. The grid runs one column on phones, two from `sm` and three from `lg`. Search and facets combine; when nothing matches, an empty state offers to clear every filter. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'story-index', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `registration-frame`, `input`, `select`, `chip`, `button` and `empty-state`; the search, the facet selections, each select's own option search and the page count are local state, and facets can be seeded from the URL query.
useWhen: Use StoryIndex for a card grid of customer stories with search and facets.
avoidWhen: For a closing row of three related stories → use `article-cards`.
For the full filterable list of articles or resources → use `article-index`.
For a filterable list of non-article rows (jobs) → use `listing-index`.
related: article-index` — the filterable list of articles or resources.
bestPractices: Derive each facet's `options` from the values the items carry, so every option matches at least one story.
Give every item a `facets` entry per facet `id`; an item without one never matches a selection on that facet.

Pass `client.logo` as any image URL or imported asset (`import gpaExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/gpa-extended-reversed.svg'`); the card fits a mark of any intrinsic size, so do not pre-scale or crop it.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered left-aligned as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: items
props.doc: The stories, in order; each is `{ id, href, client, category, description, facets?, target? }`; a story whose `target` is `_blank` opens in a new tab.

props.name: facets
props.doc: The facet selects, in order; each is `{ id, label, allLabel, options }`.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the search field; the field is omitted when this and `searchAriaLabel` are both empty.

props.name: searchShortPlaceholder
props.doc: Shorter placeholder of the search field below `lg`; empty uses `searchPlaceholder`.

props.name: searchAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the search field.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.doc: Message of the no-match state; the state renders only with it.

props.name: emptyActionLabel
props.doc: Label of the no-match state's button that clears every filter; no button renders without it.

props.name: linkLabel
props.doc: Read cue at the foot of each card, also the lead of its accessible name.

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Label of the load-more button under the grid; without it every match is listed and no button renders.

props.name: pageSize
props.doc: Stories listed per page when `moreLabel` is set; the load-more button reveals the next page.

props.name: filterLabel
props.doc: Label of the filter button below `lg`; empty uses the locale catalog (`Filters`).

props.name: seedFromQuery
props.doc: Seeds each facet on mount from the URL query parameter named by its `id` when the value is one of its options.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of stories.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import axurExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/axur-extended-reversed.svg'
  import exameExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/exame-extended-reversed.svg'
  import gpaExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/gpa-extended-reversed.svg'
  import StoryIndex from '@aziontech/webkit/story-index'
</script>

<template>
  <StoryIndex
    anchor="cases"
    title="Companies building with Azion"
    aria-label="Success stories"
    link-label="Read story"
    more-label="Load more"
    :items="[
      {
        id: 'case-gpa',
        href: '/site/success-cases/gpa',
        client: { name: 'GPA', logo: gpaExtendedReversed },
        category: 'Retail',
        description:
          'Grupo Pão de Açúcar (GPA) solved a targeted DNS attack, secured 100+ critical applications in 15 days, and reduced costs by 30%.',
        facets: { industry: ['Retail'], solution: ['Secure'] }
      },
      {
        id: 'case-axur',
        href: '/site/success-cases/axur',
        client: { name: 'Axur', logo: axurExtendedReversed },
        category: 'Tech',
        description:
          'See how moving AI inference off managed infrastructure unlocked the fastest automatic takedown in the market.',
        facets: { industry: ['Tech'], solution: ['Build', 'Secure'] }
      },
      {
        id: 'case-exame',
        href: '/site/success-cases/exame',
        client: { name: 'Exame', logo: exameExtendedReversed },
        category: 'Media',
        description:
          'Faster content delivery and resilient infrastructure enabled Exame to handle large traffic spikes during major news events.',
        facets: { industry: ['Media'], solution: ['Build', 'Deploy'] }
      }
    ]"
    :facets="[
      {
        id: 'industry',
        label: 'Industry',
        allLabel: 'All industries',
        options: [
          { value: 'Media', label: 'Media' },
          { value: 'Retail', label: 'Retail' },
          { value: 'Tech', label: 'Tech' }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: 'solution',
        label: 'Solution',
        allLabel: 'All solutions',
        options: [
          { value: 'Build', label: 'Build' },
          { value: 'Deploy', label: 'Deploy' },
          { value: 'Secure', label: 'Secure' }
        ]
      }
    ]"
    search-placeholder="Search by company or story"
    search-aria-label="Search success stories"
    empty-title="No stories match these filters."
    empty-action-label="View all success stories"
  />
</template>
